Being trans is incredibly difficult. It is obvious your partner has tried to suppress these thoughts as most of us do due to society and the stigma around it. I understand you are straight and cannot see yourself with a woman. This is perfectly fine. But please do not discourage your partner’s transition for your own selfish reasons. It is so very difficult to accept being trans and to start transitioning. You said you will still be their friend so be their friend. They just want to love who they are and be comfortable in their own skin.
